name: Thonos
backstory: Gavv, disguised as Harper Thonos, is a Doppelganger posing as a gold dwarf member of the Harpers. Originally on a mission to look into Bhaalist activity in the city and to find the whereabouts of the Mad Rashemaar, Thonos was killed and impersonated some time ago.
